integrity: The analytic proof rests on a classical exponential-polynomial zero bound and an original constructive SIR comparison. Finite numerical checks are illustrative, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only exact deterministic SIR susceptibility mixtures with fixed initial fractions, homogeneous infectiousness and exactly specified transmission-to-recovery ratios; arbitrary infinite-support laws and finite stochastic outbreak distributions are outside scope.
title: Sharp \(2k-3\) attack-size ranking reversals among equal-mean susceptibility mixtures
